newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT CLOSES SLIGHTLY UP VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT CLOSES SLIGHTLY UP VS DOLLAR.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly up against the dollar in quiet trading on Monday.
The forint finished at 155.36/41 to one dollar, a shade firmer than its opening of 155.47/52, dealers said.
"The move was a result of a weaker dollar internationally," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank, adding that little was likely to move the market domestically in the next few days.
"The dollar/mark cross will stay the main factor," he said.
The forint remained some 20 fillers weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level.
